name: Mac Pro 2013
author: Nom de la Société
description: The go-to plugin for a Late 2013 Mac Pro (aka Trashcan or Cylinder). Everything this machine needs to run nicely on Omarchy: both FirePros (D300, D500 or D700), a lock that keeps the picture, Sleep off, auto Wi-Fi repair, and GPU per app. One Apply and you're at 100%.
